name: Supine Pelvic Tilt
steps: Rest on your back with both soles on the floor, knees pointing up and arms loose beside your hips.
Exhale and gently contract your abs and glutes to rock your pelvis backward, flattening your lower back smoothly into the floor.
Inhale and slowly tilt your pelvis forward to restore a small, comfortable natural arch beneath your lower back.
Continue rocking smoothly between flattened and gently arched pelvic positions for the target duration.
tips: Keep your glutes and shoulders relaxed enough that the motion stays small, smooth, and focused in your pelvis.
Do not lift your hips completely off the floor into a full bridge.
